title: Hardwood floor refinish
scopeLines: Hardwood refinish: **1,200 sq ft** (living, halls, bedrooms on the same two-story house as the siding job)
Shoe molding: **180 lf** pull and reset
Wizard hardwood labor: **$6.50 / sq ft** hard cost, then profit margin
scopeNotes: Desktop wizard stopped on hardwood labor $6.50 / sq ft (Aug 16 2026). This quote finishes that job with the same markup rules as siding.
$6.50 is hard-cost labor (sand, stain, and finish coats). 30% profit is applied on top — quoted labor is $8.45 / sq ft.
1,200 sq ft is a working takeoff for this house: first + second floor living, halls, and bedrooms. Excludes baths, kitchen, and laundry. Tape rooms to lock the number.
This is a refinish of existing hardwood, not a new plank install. New flooring wood would be a separate material buy (same as the $160 window-trim wood).
Does not include repairs to cupped / rotten boards, stair nosing rebuild, or moving off-site storage.
